adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, migrated hosts are inserted via raw SQL using the old `site_settings` value (`records.each do |h| execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`). This bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. Later, allow-checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` which parses the referer URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. If the migrated DB row contains `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`, it will not equal `discourse.org` / `example.com`, so `host_allowed?` will return false and embedding will be rejected after upgrade for such existing configurations (which the old setting logic/tests explicitly supported).
